hooks.text: 舰船装备选择直接生成卡组牌与协同
hooks.excerpt: Find unique synergies between your options as each choice comes with an associated set of cards for your deck, with additional cards and upgrades unlocked at your discretion after each victorious encounter
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 船员士气、个性与阵营忠诚共同管理
hooks.excerpt: Gather crew to operate your equipment, managing their morale and taking advantage of their unique skills and the benefits they provide your outfit, as well as their relationships with the factions you might encounter. But be warned, crew members have their own personalities and allegiances to remain mindful of.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 预判敌方行动并围绕关键设备规划回合
hooks.excerpt: Your sensors will pick up on enemy activity, letting you know what to expect when they strike. Calculate cooldown times and strategize around enemy equipment that poses the greatest threat to you in upcoming turns.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
